Wave 23 is a DESIGN WAVE for the highest-value remaining design gate: per-workspace execution profile. The W11-W16 Cloud-runner crux built a config-keyed :execution_profile resolver in ClaudeChat.command/2 (:self_hosted default | :cloud), but W15 explicitly declined per-workspace routing as premature — zero consumers, nothing sets :execution_profile anywhere. Today every chat turn resolves the SAME global profile regardless of workspace. W23 adds the missing consumer seam: a workspace CHOOSES its execution profile so its chat turns route to the sandboxed cloud runner (or stay self-hosted) per that workspace's setting. Phase A ratifies the design as a real charter decision (D205+): WHERE the setting lives, the DEFAULT (absent → :self_hosted, fail-safe not fail-cloud), the READ PATH (command/2 resolves the turn's workspace → looks up its profile), and how it composes with the global config override. Phase B builds it: setting storage + command/2 routing + a RED-FIRST protective test (workspace A profile=:cloud resolves :cloud argv; workspace B unset resolves :self_hosted; test REDS on today's global-only resolver). All offline/argv-layer — the LIVE cloud turn stays human-gated per connectors-hg-live-isolated-cloud-turn. Scope: ONE capability, 1-2 slices; Studio/admin toggle only if it lands without router.ex overreach. Do not touch other design gates or knob-4 (D148-blocked). W21 tenancy-catalog lesson applies to any NEW workspace_id table.

The finished experience: an operator flips one workspace-level setting and every subsequent chat turn in THAT workspace spawns through the cloud-sandbox-runner argv — no deploy, no global config edit, every other workspace untouched and defaulting self-hosted. The strategist's pre-survey read of origin/main already found the likely seam, which the survey must confirm or kill:

LEAN 1 — STORAGE: reuse the existing workspaces.settings jsonb map. Barkpark.Plugins.Enablement already ratified this exact pattern (workspaces.settings["plugins"] as a per-workspace override layer with fail-safe resolution: nil workspace or ANY lookup failure → declaration defaults). Propose settings["chat"]["execution_profile"] = "cloud" | "self_hosted". No new table → no migration → NO tenancy-catalog edit (workspaces is the E1 root — verify). This beats a new workspace_settings table (schema + migration + catalog + WorkspaceBundleTest churn for one key) and beats a dedicated column (jsonb namespacing scales to future chat knobs).

LEAN 2 — DEFAULT + FAIL DIRECTION: absent, malformed, or unreadable setting → :self_hosted resolution falls through to the EXISTING global config default. Failure mode prevented: defaulting :cloud would route every workspace's turns into a sandbox needing a live Vercel token + Anthropic key the instance may not have → instance-wide dead chat. BUT the inverse fail-safe matters too and is the subtler decision: once a workspace has EXPLICITLY chosen :cloud, a downstream failure (missing sandbox_runner, dead creds) must FAIL THE TURN LOUDLY, never silently fall back to :self_hosted — the workspace chose the sandbox for isolation; a silent fallback hands host access to exactly the tenant that opted out of it. Absent-setting → safe default; explicit-cloud → fail-closed. Name both in D205.

LEAN 3 — READ PATH: command/2 already receives session_opts carrying workspace_id (D110 threaded it via studio_chat/runtime/claude.ex, hard-required for cloud turns). Change execution_profile/0 to a workspace-aware execution_profile(session_opts): concrete workspace_id → settings lookup → per-workspace value; nil/:global workspace or no setting → global config → :self_hosted. CRITICAL TRAP the wish didn't name: there is a SECOND consumer — maybe_thread_cloud_tool_descriptors/1 in the runtime gates on ClaudeChat.execution_profile() == :cloud to thread knob-3 tool descriptors. If it stays global-only, a cloud-profiled workspace on a self-hosted-default instance gets a cloud turn WITHOUT its tool descriptors (silent capability loss). Both call sites must resolve through the same workspace-aware path. Survey must find any third consumer.

LEAN 4 — COMPOSITION with global config: per-workspace WINS when explicitly set, in both directions (a workspace can opt INTO cloud on a self-hosted-default instance, and opt OUT back to self-hosted on a cloud-default one); the global config is the default for unset workspaces, not a ceiling. Simplicity argument: a ceiling adds a second policy knob with no consumer today — same premature-abstraction smell W15 killed. The :command tuple override stays the outermost bypass (verbatim, pre-profile) exactly as today. Open question for Decide: whether an instance that CANNOT run cloud (no runner configured) should refuse the setting at WRITE time (validation) vs fail at turn time.

LEAN 5 — SCOPE: slice 1 = setting read path + workspace-aware resolution in both consumers + red-first ExUnit proof (targeted file only; full suite OOMs locally; inherited 4-test flake rotates per #3558/D166). Slice 2 (only if survey finds an existing workspace-settings write surface that reaches it without router.ex changes) = minimal setting write path / admin toggle; otherwise file the toggle as a follow-up task and ship the seam consumable via the existing settings write mechanism. Repo-read safety must be checked: command/2 runs at spawn time in the runtime process — a per-turn Repo read is likely fine and Enablement's registry-deadlock invariant (nil workspace → no Repo read) must be honored.

Default: nil workspace/absent/malformed/lookup-failure falls through to global config then :self_hosted — fail-safe, because defaulting cloud routes every workspace into a sandbox whose keys/binaries exist nowhere; but an EXPLICIT cloud that cannot execute FAILS THE TURN LOUDLY (binary_not_found fast; 401 result frame loud; vercel misconfig loud-but-slow, 10m backstop — named). Composition: per-workspace WINS both directions when set; global is the unset default, NOT a ceiling; :command tuple stays the outermost bypass. D107 reconciled (workspace = coarser tenancy axis, not the rejected per-session enum). Fences: Codex out (no seam), knob-4/per-workspace KEYS blocked (D148(1)/D198 — key stays flat ambient env), live cloud turn stays human-gated.

Why: otherwise the wave's own goal — one workspace flips one setting and ONLY that workspace's turns change — is violated on day one for the flat admin route.

D207 — the write surface: SettingsLive toggle (plugin .bp_switch clone at the already-mounted canonical scoped route), ZERO router.ex, PLUS a per-write workspace_admin?/2 re-gate on the toggle event (ConnectorsLive precedent). Why: the mount gate is coarser than the wish assumed (V5) and execution_profile is routing-security-relevant — it routes a tenant's turns into a sandbox sharing ONE flat instance key. Two slices in flight: W23-1 connectors-per-workspace-execution-profile (FABLE) then W23-2 connectors-execution-profile-settings-toggle (OPUS, sequenced). Backlog filed: connectors-liveauth-admin-target-workspace, connectors-sandbox-runner-deploy-install. Epic task-e640bb01fca6ea38. Next: builders claim, build in worktrees off origin/main, lead integrates on loop-epic/connectors-w23-integration; Review closes the story.

The wish

Wave 23 is a DESIGN WAVE for the highest-value remaining design gate: per-workspace execution profile. The W11-W16 Cloud-runner crux built a config-keyed :execution_profile resolver in ClaudeChat.command/2 (:self_hosted default | :cloud), but W15 explicitly declined per-workspace routing as premature — zero consumers, nothing sets :execution_profile anywhere. Today every chat turn resolves the SAME global profile regardless of workspace. W23 adds the missing consumer seam: a workspace CHOOSES its execution profile so its chat turns route to the sandboxed cloud runner (or stay self-hosted) per that workspace's setting. Phase A ratifies the design as a real charter decision (D205+): WHERE the setting lives, the DEFAULT (absent → :self_hosted, fail-safe not fail-cloud), the READ PATH (command/2 resolves the turn's workspace → looks up its profile), and how it composes with the global config override. Phase B builds it: setting storage + command/2 routing + a RED-FIRST protective test (workspace A profile=:cloud resolves :cloud argv; workspace B unset resolves :self_hosted; test REDS on today's global-only resolver). All offline/argv-layer — the LIVE cloud turn stays human-gated per connectors-hg-live-isolated-cloud-turn. Scope: ONE capability, 1-2 slices; Studio/admin toggle only if it lands without router.ex overreach. Do not touch other design gates or knob-4 (D148-blocked). W21 tenancy-catalog lesson applies to any NEW workspace_id table.

Strategic direction (tentative — Decide finalizes)

The finished experience: an operator flips one workspace-level setting and every subsequent chat turn in THAT workspace spawns through the cloud-sandbox-runner argv — no deploy, no global config edit, every other workspace untouched and defaulting self-hosted. The strategist's pre-survey read of origin/main already found the likely seam, which the survey must confirm or kill:

LEAN 1 — STORAGE: reuse the existing workspaces.settings jsonb map. Barkpark.Plugins.Enablement already ratified this exact pattern (workspaces.settings["plugins"] as a per-workspace override layer with fail-safe resolution: nil workspace or ANY lookup failure → declaration defaults). Propose settings["chat"]["execution_profile"] = "cloud" | "self_hosted". No new table → no migration → NO tenancy-catalog edit (workspaces is the E1 root — verify). This beats a new workspace_settings table (schema + migration + catalog + WorkspaceBundleTest churn for one key) and beats a dedicated column (jsonb namespacing scales to future chat knobs).

LEAN 2 — DEFAULT + FAIL DIRECTION: absent, malformed, or unreadable setting → :self_hosted resolution falls through to the EXISTING global config default. Failure mode prevented: defaulting :cloud would route every workspace's turns into a sandbox needing a live Vercel token + Anthropic key the instance may not have → instance-wide dead chat. BUT the inverse fail-safe matters too and is the subtler decision: once a workspace has EXPLICITLY chosen :cloud, a downstream failure (missing sandbox_runner, dead creds) must FAIL THE TURN LOUDLY, never silently fall back to :self_hosted — the workspace chose the sandbox for isolation; a silent fallback hands host access to exactly the tenant that opted out of it. Absent-setting → safe default; explicit-cloud → fail-closed. Name both in D205.

LEAN 3 — READ PATH: command/2 already receives session_opts carrying workspace_id (D110 threaded it via studio_chat/runtime/claude.ex, hard-required for cloud turns). Change execution_profile/0 to a workspace-aware execution_profile(session_opts): concrete workspace_id → settings lookup → per-workspace value; nil/:global workspace or no setting → global config → :self_hosted. CRITICAL TRAP the wish didn't name: there is a SECOND consumer — maybe_thread_cloud_tool_descriptors/1 in the runtime gates on ClaudeChat.execution_profile() == :cloud to thread knob-3 tool descriptors. If it stays global-only, a cloud-profiled workspace on a self-hosted-default instance gets a cloud turn WITHOUT its tool descriptors (silent capability loss). Both call sites must resolve through the same workspace-aware path. Survey must find any third consumer.

LEAN 4 — COMPOSITION with global config: per-workspace WINS when explicitly set, in both directions (a workspace can opt INTO cloud on a self-hosted-default instance, and opt OUT back to self-hosted on a cloud-default one); the global config is the default for unset workspaces, not a ceiling. Simplicity argument: a ceiling adds a second policy knob with no consumer today — same premature-abstraction smell W15 killed. The :command tuple override stays the outermost bypass (verbatim, pre-profile) exactly as today. Open question for Decide: whether an instance that CANNOT run cloud (no runner configured) should refuse the setting at WRITE time (validation) vs fail at turn time.

LEAN 5 — SCOPE: slice 1 = setting read path + workspace-aware resolution in both consumers + red-first ExUnit proof (targeted file only; full suite OOMs locally; inherited 4-test flake rotates per #3558/D166). Slice 2 (only if survey finds an existing workspace-settings write surface that reaches it without router.ex changes) = minimal setting write path / admin toggle; otherwise file the toggle as a follow-up task and ship the seam consumable via the existing settings write mechanism. Repo-read safety must be checked: command/2 runs at spawn time in the runtime process — a per-turn Repo read is likely fine and Enablement's registry-deadlock invariant (nil workspace → no Repo read) must be honored.

Survey plan (13 scouts, in flight)

1. execution-profile-resolver — exact current resolver + every consumer of execution_profile/0 (command/2, maybe_thread_cloud_tool_descriptors, any third). Why: the change surface must be complete or a cloud workspace loses capabilities silently. 2. workspace-settings-store — the workspaces.settings jsonb pattern: schema, changeset, existing namespaces, Enablement read discipline. Why: confirms or kills LEAN 1. 3. workspace-resolution-in-chat — how a turn's workspace_id reaches session_opts on BOTH profiles (D110 threading; owner_workspace_id seam). Why: LEAN 3 assumes self-hosted turns also carry workspace_id — if false the read path needs threading work. 4. repo-read-safety — process context of command/2; Repo-read safety at spawn time; Enablement deadlock invariant; caching precedent. Why: decides raw read vs cached vs pre-resolved-upstream. 5. tenancy-catalog — confirm workspaces is E1-root and settings-only change needs no catalog edit. Why: W21 lesson; full-suite CI reds on WorkspaceBundleTest drift. 6. charter-d-numbers — W15 decline verbatim, D148/knob-4 boundary, latest D number so Decide numbers D205+ correctly. Why: the ratification must cite what it overturns. 7. settings-write-path — how workspaces.settings gets WRITTEN today (API route? Studio LiveView? bp CLI? seeds?). Why: decides whether slice 2 is a toggle or a follow-up. 8. cloud-turn-prereqs — everything a :cloud turn needs beyond argv (runner on PATH, Vercel creds, W21/22 run-secrets, cloud_sandbox_id binding). Why: names the failure mode when a workspace flips cloud on an unprepared instance (feeds LEAN 2 fail-closed). 9. tests-inventory — existing command/2 / execution_profile / cloud_build_args tests: files, config-injection idioms, the ClaudeChatTest stderr flake. Why: builders extend the right file and honor the vacuous-green law (:command bypasses build_args). 10. epic-ledger — the connectors-per-workspace-execution-profile task detail + sibling tasks touching this seam + foreign claims/open PRs (multi-session checkout). Why: dedup before launch. 11. config-override-composition — where :claude_chat config is set across config/*.exs + runtime.exs + prod env; does ANYTHING set :execution_profile today (would contradict W15's zero-consumers and reshape LEAN 4). 12. studio-toggle-surface — where workspace-level admin settings render in Studio; can a toggle land without router.ex changes; effort. 13. codex-parity — does runtime/codex.ex have a parallel command seam needing the same workspace awareness, or is execution_profile claude-only by design. Why: scope fence — name it, don't build it.

MERGE DISCIPLINE (W11-W22 proven): integration branch loop-epic/connectors-w23-integration in a FRESH worktree off CURRENT origin/main (never merge in the primary checkout — it is stale/diverged; read code via git show origin/main:<path>). Builders branch off origin/main. Elixir gate: elixir.yml; targeted test file only; inherited flake set per D166/#3558. If Decide's charter commit lands on local main only, cherry-pick it into the integration PR keeping BOTH rotating-charter sections. PRs carry Task: <slug> per slice; claim task at PR-open. Every fix pins a test that REDS first. router.ex/theme/paper/golden/deploy_runner off-limits.

Digest — survey synthesis (2026-07-17)

ESTABLISHED, with file:line evidence and multi-scout convergence. (1) CONSUMERS: execution_profile() has exactly TWO production call sites repo-wide, BOTH in api/lib/barkpark_web/studio/claude_chat.ex — command/2 at L128 and maybe_thread_cloud_tool_descriptors/1 at L1523-1530, a private function nested inside the Session GenServer submodule (defmodule at L1072), called from Session.init/1 at L1153, two lines before the command/2 call at L1155. Four independent exhaustive greps found no third consumer in api/lib. Both consumers run in the SAME init/1 callback a few lines apart, so ONE workspace lookup can feed both — this collapses the feared two-file lockstep problem into a single-file substitution. (2) THREADING: session_opts already carries :workspace_id on EVERY turn, self-hosted included (D110: runtime/claude.ex:56-71 unconditional Map.put; chat_controller.ex:552 -> recorder.ex:146). No new plumbing needed. Host-admin/:global sessions carry owner_workspace_id = nil (SQL NULL, studio_chat.ex:98-104) — the new resolver must treat nil as fall-through to global/:self_hosted, matching the cloud_workspace_id! fail-closed precedent (claude_chat.ex:341-351). (3) STORAGE (Lean 1 CONFIRMED): workspaces.settings jsonb exists (workspace.ex:51, migration 20260709200000), already hosts two namespaces ("theme", "plugins") each with a dedicated Tenancy accessor pair using merge-in-place Map.put writes and fail-safe reads (tenancy.ex:341-396, 419-464). There is NO generic settings writer — settings["chat"] needs a NEW accessor pair (workspace_chat_settings/1 + set_workspace_chat_settings/2). NOTE: the separately-named plugin_settings TABLE is a global encrypted per-plugin credential store (keyed by plugin_name, no workspace_id) — NOT a storage candidate. (4) TENANCY-CATALOG TRAP DODGED: workspaces is @root_table in workspace_bundle/catalog.ex, outside E1/E2/E3; a new jsonb key triggers zero assert_partition! drift and zero WorkspaceBundleTest edits — conditional on slice 2 introducing NO new table. (5) CHARTER: D205 is next-free (charter caps at D204, line 986). The governing decline is D148(2) — cite the sub-item specifically, never bare D148 (D148(1) knob-4 stays blocked per D198). D107's 'never a per-session user choice' rejected the per-SESSION execution_target enum axis, not workspace-level config; D205 must reconcile this explicitly. (6) GLOBAL CONFIG IS UNINSTANTIATED EVERYWHERE: no config/*.exs, deploy/ (25 files), cloud/, or any of ~30 sibling worktrees sets :execution_profile or :sandbox_runner — only tests via put_chat_config (claude_chat_test.exs:69-82). :self_hosted is the only value that has ever been live; the opt-OUT direction (per-workspace self_hosted under a global :cloud) has no live case. (7) REPO-READ SAFETY: command/2 runs inside Session.init/1 — per-session (self-hosted keeps one Port open across turns), human-cadence bounded; the Registry/Enablement deadlock is a Registry-self-call hazard that does NOT apply here; uncached Repo.get precedent is Enablement.effective/1 at per-render frequency, higher than per-session-init. A plain Tenancy.get_workspace_by_id/1 read in init/1 is safe and precedented. (8) TESTS: the execution-profile describes (claude_chat_test.exs:859-894) all call the zero-arg resolver — the red-first workspace proof is a genuinely NEW describe, not an extension. VACUOUS-GREEN LAW: the :command config override bypasses the argv builders verbatim — the proof MUST use :sandbox_runner/:binary overrides so cloud_build_args/build_args actually run. Flake #3558 (claude_chat_test.exs:747) is inherited: cite, never re-file, re-run once if it trips alone. (9) CLOUD-TURN FAIL-LOUD GROUNDING for D205's Lean 2: missing runner binary -> {:stop, :binary_not_found} fast and loud (claude_chat.ex:1157-1162); bad/missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -> honest 401 result frame (live-proven, D113(c)); misconfigured vercel CLI -> loud but SLOW (bounded only by the 10m create backstop). D205's fail-loud language must qualify latency on that third path. The sandbox key is flat ambient env by design (D110/D23) — NO run-secrets integration feeds it; per-workspace KEYS are knob-4/D9-blocked and explicitly out of W23 scope. (10) CODEX: no parallel argv seam, zero execution_profile consumption (own :codex_app_server namespace, direct Port.open) — D205 should ratify the claude-only scope fence in one cheap explicit line. (11) LEDGER: task connectors-per-workspace-execution-profile is open and unclaimed, no duplicate task, no open PR touches this surface.

CORRECTIONS TO THE STRATEGIC DIRECTION (trust these over the Strategize text): (a) The 'second consumer' is NOT in runtime/claude.ex — five scouts independently place maybe_thread_cloud_tool_descriptors/1 in claude_chat.ex:1523-1530; a builder grepping runtime/claude.ex finds nothing there (that file only does D110 workspace_id threading). (b) The wish's implication that W21/W22 run-secrets feeds the sandbox's Anthropic key is wrong — the key is ambient env passthrough only; do not let D205 assume per-workspace credentials exist. (c) One scout's quick grep missed workspaces field :settings — outvoted by two direct reads plus the migration; the column exists.

Coverage map — what was checked

CHECKED AND FOUND: claude_chat.ex read in full (resolver L143-149 default :self_hosted L135, command/2 L122-133, cloud_build_args L219-227, cloud_workspace_id! L341-351, Session submodule L1072+, second consumer L1523-1530, env scrub L692-727); runtime/claude.ex in full (79 lines, D110 threading only); recorder.ex:146 + chat_controller.ex:544-570 (workspace_id unconditional); studio_chat.ex scope stamping; tenancy.ex accessor pairs + workspace.ex schema; enablement.ex fail-safe pattern + registry/resolver_chain deadlock mechanics; workspace_bundle/catalog.ex root-table proof + workspace_bundle_test.exs drift trigger; charter D107/D148/D166/D187/D198/D204 verbatim; claude_chat_test.exs idioms + cloud_session_test DataCase pattern; settings_live.ex toggle pattern + router.ex:1210-1237 existing admin route; cloud-sandbox-runner.mjs prereqs + failure modes; codex.ex + codex/session.ex (zero profile awareness); config/*.exs + deploy/ + cloud/ (zero :execution_profile anywhere); bp ledger (task unclaimed, no dup, no open PR).

CORNERS NO SCOUT REACHED (the verify fleet closes these): (a) NOTHING WAS RUN — every claim above is read-proof only; the red-first premise (test REDS on today's resolver) is asserted, not executed. (b) chat_live.ex:3786's Recorder.ensure call (the LiveView/Studio entry path — the PRIMARY consumer) was grep-located but never read; if it threads workspace_id differently, per-workspace routing silently misses Studio-originated turns. (c) claude_chat_real_binary_test.exs (1114 lines) never opened — may pin command/2 argv in ways a resolver change breaks. Verify plan — 5 assignments in flight

V1 red-first-argv-proof [OPUS, worktree, MUST RUN]: in a fresh worktree off origin/main, write the W23 protective test — workspace A with settings["chat"]["execution_profile"]="cloud" (real Workspace row; settings written directly since no chat accessor exists yet) expects command/2 with session_opts %{workspace_id: A.id} to resolve sandbox_runner argv; workspace B unset expects binary() argv; global config left UNSET; :sandbox_runner/:binary overrides only, never :command (vacuous-green law). PROVE it reds today (A's assertion fails, B's passes) by running CC=clang mix test on the new file; also run the existing claude_chat_test.exs green and report whether that file is DB-capable (DataCase?) or the new test needs its own DataCase file — this shapes slice 1's test placement. DECIDE PREVIEW (grounded leans, pending verify): D205 ratifies settings["chat"]["execution_profile"] in workspaces.settings jsonb via a new Tenancy accessor pair; resolution order = explicit :command tuple (test bypass, outermost) > per-workspace setting when present and valid > global config > :self_hosted; nil/malformed setting or nil workspace -> fall-through (fail-safe); per-workspace WINS both directions when set, global is default not ceiling; ONE lookup in Session.init/1 feeds BOTH consumers; Codex explicitly out of scope; per-workspace KEYS (knob-4) explicitly out of scope; slice 1 = resolver + accessor + red-first proof, slice 2 = SettingsLive toggle (zero router.ex) or follow-up task.

Verification results — 5 assignments, all with run output

V1 red-first-argv-proof (Opus, EXECUTED): the wave premise is proven runnable, not argued. A fresh-worktree DataCase probe off origin/main (workspace A settings chat.execution_profile="cloud", workspace B unset, global config UNSET, :binary/:sandbox_runner overrides — never :command) REDs exactly as predicted: "2 tests, 1 failure ... got \"selfhosted-marker\" (today's resolver ignores workspace_id and reads the global config only)"; workspace B passes. Decisions — D205, D206, D207 (charter commit 955ecfaa6; full text in .claude/workflows/bp-connectors-charter.md)

D205 — per-workspace execution profile RATIFIED (the fresh record D148(2) demanded). Storage: settings["chat"]["execution_profile"] in the existing workspaces.settings jsonb via a new Tenancy accessor pair (theme/plugins clone) — no migration, no new table, no tenancy-catalog edit (workspaces is @root_table; W21 trap structurally dodged). Composition: per-workspace WINS both directions when set; global is the unset default, NOT a ceiling; :command tuple stays the outermost bypass. D107 reconciled (workspace = coarser tenancy axis, not the rejected per-session enum). Fences: Codex out (no seam), knob-4/per-workspace KEYS blocked (D148(1)/D198 — key stays flat ambient env), live cloud turn stays human-gated.

Why: otherwise the wave's own goal — one workspace flips one setting and ONLY that workspace's turns change — is violated on day one for the flat admin route.

D207 — the write surface: SettingsLive toggle (plugin .bp_switch clone at the already-mounted canonical scoped route), ZERO router.ex, PLUS a per-write workspace_admin?/2 re-gate on the toggle event (ConnectorsLive precedent). Why: the mount gate is coarser than the wish assumed (V5) and execution_profile is routing-security-relevant — it routes a tenant's turns into a sandbox sharing ONE flat instance key. Theme/plugins keep today's behavior; the general LiveAuth coarseness is backlog (connectors-liveauth-admin-target-workspace), not wave overreach.

The wish

Wave 23 is a DESIGN WAVE for the highest-value remaining design gate: per-workspace execution profile. The W11-W16 Cloud-runner crux built a config-keyed :execution_profile resolver in ClaudeChat.command/2 (:self_hosted default | :cloud), but W15 explicitly declined per-workspace routing as premature — zero consumers, nothing sets :execution_profile anywhere. Today every chat turn resolves the SAME global profile regardless of workspace. W23 adds the missing consumer seam: a workspace CHOOSES its execution profile so its chat turns route to the sandboxed cloud runner (or stay self-hosted) per that workspace's setting. Phase A ratifies the design as a real charter decision (D205+): WHERE the setting lives, the DEFAULT (absent → :self_hosted, fail-safe not fail-cloud), the READ PATH (command/2 resolves the turn's workspace → looks up its profile), and how it composes with the global config override. Phase B builds it: setting storage + command/2 routing + a RED-FIRST protective test (workspace A profile=:cloud resolves :cloud argv; workspace B unset resolves :self_hosted; test REDS on today's global-only resolver). All offline/argv-layer — the LIVE cloud turn stays human-gated per connectors-hg-live-isolated-cloud-turn. Scope: ONE capability, 1-2 slices; Studio/admin toggle only if it lands without router.ex overreach. Do not touch other design gates or knob-4 (D148-blocked). W21 tenancy-catalog lesson applies to any NEW workspace_id table.

Strategic direction (tentative — Decide finalizes)

The finished experience: an operator flips one workspace-level setting and every subsequent chat turn in THAT workspace spawns through the cloud-sandbox-runner argv — no deploy, no global config edit, every other workspace untouched and defaulting self-hosted. The strategist's pre-survey read of origin/main already found the likely seam, which the survey must confirm or kill:

LEAN 1 — STORAGE: reuse the existing workspaces.settings jsonb map. Barkpark.Plugins.Enablement already ratified this exact pattern (workspaces.settings["plugins"] as a per-workspace override layer with fail-safe resolution: nil workspace or ANY lookup failure → declaration defaults). Propose settings["chat"]["execution_profile"] = "cloud" | "self_hosted". No new table → no migration → NO tenancy-catalog edit (workspaces is the E1 root — verify). This beats a new workspace_settings table (schema + migration + catalog + WorkspaceBundleTest churn for one key) and beats a dedicated column (jsonb namespacing scales to future chat knobs).

LEAN 2 — DEFAULT + FAIL DIRECTION: absent, malformed, or unreadable setting → :self_hosted resolution falls through to the EXISTING global config default. Failure mode prevented: defaulting :cloud would route every workspace's turns into a sandbox needing a live Vercel token + Anthropic key the instance may not have → instance-wide dead chat. BUT the inverse fail-safe matters too and is the subtler decision: once a workspace has EXPLICITLY chosen :cloud, a downstream failure (missing sandbox_runner, dead creds) must FAIL THE TURN LOUDLY, never silently fall back to :self_hosted — the workspace chose the sandbox for isolation; a silent fallback hands host access to exactly the tenant that opted out of it. Absent-setting → safe default; explicit-cloud → fail-closed. Name both in D205.

LEAN 3 — READ PATH: command/2 already receives session_opts carrying workspace_id (D110 threaded it via studio_chat/runtime/claude.ex, hard-required for cloud turns). Change execution_profile/0 to a workspace-aware execution_profile(session_opts): concrete workspace_id → settings lookup → per-workspace value; nil/:global workspace or no setting → global config → :self_hosted. CRITICAL TRAP the wish didn't name: there is a SECOND consumer — maybe_thread_cloud_tool_descriptors/1 in the runtime gates on ClaudeChat.execution_profile() == :cloud to thread knob-3 tool descriptors. If it stays global-only, a cloud-profiled workspace on a self-hosted-default instance gets a cloud turn WITHOUT its tool descriptors (silent capability loss). Both call sites must resolve through the same workspace-aware path. Survey must find any third consumer.

LEAN 4 — COMPOSITION with global config: per-workspace WINS when explicitly set, in both directions (a workspace can opt INTO cloud on a self-hosted-default instance, and opt OUT back to self-hosted on a cloud-default one); the global config is the default for unset workspaces, not a ceiling. Simplicity argument: a ceiling adds a second policy knob with no consumer today — same premature-abstraction smell W15 killed. The :command tuple override stays the outermost bypass (verbatim, pre-profile) exactly as today. Open question for Decide: whether an instance that CANNOT run cloud (no runner configured) should refuse the setting at WRITE time (validation) vs fail at turn time.

LEAN 5 — SCOPE: slice 1 = setting read path + workspace-aware resolution in both consumers + red-first ExUnit proof (targeted file only; full suite OOMs locally; inherited 4-test flake rotates per #3558/D166). Slice 2 (only if survey finds an existing workspace-settings write surface that reaches it without router.ex changes) = minimal setting write path / admin toggle; otherwise file the toggle as a follow-up task and ship the seam consumable via the existing settings write mechanism. Repo-read safety must be checked: command/2 runs at spawn time in the runtime process — a per-turn Repo read is likely fine and Enablement's registry-deadlock invariant (nil workspace → no Repo read) must be honored.

Survey plan (13 scouts, in flight)

1. execution-profile-resolver — exact current resolver + every consumer of execution_profile/0 (command/2, maybe_thread_cloud_tool_descriptors, any third). Why: the change surface must be complete or a cloud workspace loses capabilities silently. 2. workspace-settings-store — the workspaces.settings jsonb pattern: schema, changeset, existing namespaces, Enablement read discipline. Why: confirms or kills LEAN 1. 3. workspace-resolution-in-chat — how a turn's workspace_id reaches session_opts on BOTH profiles (D110 threading; owner_workspace_id seam). Why: LEAN 3 assumes self-hosted turns also carry workspace_id — if false the read path needs threading work. 4. repo-read-safety — process context of command/2; Repo-read safety at spawn time; Enablement deadlock invariant; caching precedent. Why: decides raw read vs cached vs pre-resolved-upstream. 5. tenancy-catalog — confirm workspaces is E1-root and settings-only change needs no catalog edit. Why: W21 lesson; full-suite CI reds on WorkspaceBundleTest drift. 6. charter-d-numbers — W15 decline verbatim, D148/knob-4 boundary, latest D number so Decide numbers D205+ correctly. Why: names the failure mode when a workspace flips cloud on an unprepared instance (feeds LEAN 2 fail-closed). 9. tests-inventory — existing command/2 / execution_profile / cloud_build_args tests: files, config-injection idioms, the ClaudeChatTest stderr flake. Why: builders extend the right file and honor the vacuous-green law (:command bypasses build_args). 10. epic-ledger — the connectors-per-workspace-execution-profile task detail + sibling tasks touching this seam + foreign claims/open PRs (multi-session checkout). Why: dedup before launch. 11. config-override-composition — where :claude_chat config is set across config/*.exs + runtime.exs + prod env; does ANYTHING set :execution_profile today (would contradict W15's zero-consumers and reshape LEAN 4). 12. studio-toggle-surface — where workspace-level admin settings render in Studio; can a toggle land without router.ex changes; effort. 13. codex-parity — does runtime/codex.ex have a parallel command seam needing the same workspace awareness, or is execution_profile claude-only by design. Why: scope fence — name it, don't build it.

Every fix pins a test that REDS first. router.ex/theme/paper/golden/deploy_runner off-limits.
